title: Injection (ghost) client strings — community sourced
note: Strings from the community list in andreaonorato/Minecraft-Cheat-Scanner (Strings Scanner.c), which identifies injection clients from a dump of javaw.exe memory strings. They could not be verified against the clients themselves, so every rule is a WEAK indicator that needs corroboration. Entries shorter than 8 characters in that list (nG@W, +(M0G.V, dinkio, Sa_Vc, 5d@56, TCNH$1, hi.a2, yCcADi, kc((k) were not adopted: across gigabytes of memory they match by chance.

defaults.falsePositives: Unverified community signature. Short or generic strings can occur in unrelated data; never act on this finding alone.
defaults.limitations: Targets old (1.7/1.8-era) injection clients; current releases are not covered.
